perspectives.title: AI Not Viable

representative_posts.author: surelyyoujokeme.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI is not even remotely profitable, and what use it generates seems to mainly come from (guess what) other AI companies who use it for (guess what) designing AI models. What a scam. Jeez. All for a fast monkey at a keyboard with spellcheck and grammar check.

representative_posts.author: rhapsodna.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Because right now AI is trying to insert itself in everything right now to find what can work and what doesn't and lot of it's not working... But a few things the quiet underbelly part is... I think ai will be used to monitor networks and infrastructure . Big companies will just quietly set aside

representative_posts.author: nemof.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: im not sure why people are desperate for the big companies to crash and burn. the brief sense of satisfaction at seeing the folly of ai will quickly be replaced a horrendous generational collapse, at least as bad as 2008, maybe worse. not sure i can cheer for that.

representative_posts.author: mrfusion.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The reality is AI is not a per person cost effective model. There's a reason Anthropic didn't total out their debt line in their IPO proposal. perspectives.title: Chelsea Embarrassing

representative_posts.author: mufcgrw1977.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Great noise from the away end in these first few minutes, Chelsea fans are just an embarrassment, shocking support, always are, think they have one song and it starts with the word ‘Chelsea’ and is then repeated over a period of time…..😂🤣😂🤣

representative_posts.author: everythingcpfc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Follow Palace Women v Chelsea Women live: goals, cards, substitutions and updates as they happen #CPFC

representative_posts.author: murshedz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Perhaps the brightest start to a match this season for United. Should be up 2-0 easy. This all means a Chelsea goal is coming any minute now. #mufc

representative_posts.author: nathanphillips.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Chelsea vs United is one of those games where I genuinely have no idea what instructions either manager gave their team

representative_posts.author: koplee74.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hard to call this match, although Chelsea look more likely

representative_posts.author: fcunitedmcr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 🔴 PRE-MATCH ENTERTAINMENT Make sure you get down early tomorrow ahead of our 3pm kick-off against Lancaster We’ve got Chelsea v Manchester United showing in the Main Bar (doors from 12pm), and live entertainment with CYCM in the SMRE Bar (doors from 1pm) #WeAreStrongerUnited

representative_posts.author: chrisbisto.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Chelsea’s front line and the freedom they have reminds me of how SAF set us up when Ronaldo, Tevez and Rooney were playing. Lots of freedom to wander. Makes it very hard to defend against. The lads will have to be very alert.

representative_posts.text: All a bit sloppy in this first 20 minutes, and we're basically shitting ourselves collectively whenever Chelsea break 😬 Understandable nerves, but we need to find some composure quickly.

representative_posts.author: pandastalteri.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Remember when Tottenham Hotspur dispatched the cowards of Chelsea? That was great.

representative_posts.author: tommitch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Chelsea 0-2 Spurs, our first win at Stamford Bridge without conceding since 1986. I missed the goals playing a gig in a pub, watched it all back the next morning, and we were even better than the highlights made out.

representative_posts.author: chrisfac23.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This fucking ref! Seemingly we aren’t allowed to tackle any Chelsea players.. whereas they can hack at United players with impunity

representative_posts.author: christinaherbst.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bruno F airball. Terrible from Chelsea to allow that counterattack.

representative_posts.text: I don't know anything about the game, but a friend recommended it to me. I'm excited to check it out. ♣️

representative_posts.author: nascentsolace.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Are any of you playing Final Fantasy Resonance? I am loving the nostalgic vibes and the interfacing with previous Final Fantasy titles. The main story might not be revolutionary, but that's fine to me. I'm loving this game!

representative_posts.author: alexrakitsky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not *exactly* a game, but the release of Summer Eternal Anthology Vol 1. made me the most hopeful about the games industry in years. You can't help but look at it in awe.

representative_posts.author: composercarman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I thoroughly enjoyed the demo of Heir of the Dog, and today the full game got released! Check it out if you enjoy classic point and click adventures!

representative_posts.author: thatbeardoadam.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Queen's Domain by Freshly Baked Games is really solid as a Kings-Field-Like. Gorgeous low-poly with some colorful dithering, fun combat, unique weapons, a funky soundtrack and some great level design so far. Highly recommended if you want a fun, challenging adventure game!

representative_posts.author: frisket.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Played this earlier in the year (on a GBC). It's genuinely impressive how much of the MGS1 experience they translated to a GBA game. From wall taps, prone positions, codec calls and even VR missions. And it's fun!

representative_posts.author: ilainme.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is an excellent game. Thank You, and if you haven't played it, what are you waiting for? Remember you're supposed to do good things for YOU as well as us.

representative_posts.author: geesebreath.games
representative_posts.text: Really, really enjoyed the original version of Lone Survivor, been meaning to play it again. You should give it a look if you like video games that I think are good and cool and creepy!

representative_posts.author: guilewinquote.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i've only played gameboy but I should check it out

representative_posts.text: Yay! We finished Grim Fandango! As an adventure game, it’s pretty stock. Get stuck? Use every object you have until the story keeps going. But as a piece of art? Grim Fandango is an amazing argument for games as an art form. Very glad to have played it.

representative_posts.author: yooahafterjosh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I have actually never finished this game before. I need to change that one of these days.

representative_posts.author: chrisshadowens.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: At the time that was possibly the only new game my arcade got so I was into it, plus I'd never played with digitized graphics like that before. Mostly, I'd go play pinball in the back because no one was playing those. That's when I fell in love with Pin-Bot.

representative_posts.author: theryusui.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i have *thoughts* about this game (good ones!) but i don't know if it'd be in the spirit of things to go blabbing i will say that for those who have read the first chapter of Yu-Gi-Oh! and remember its "stab your hand for money" game, the comparison is more than just superficial

representative_posts.author: terramachina.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The two boss fights I've gotten so far though were surprisingly fun and the story isn't super special but the characters are actually enjoyable. It's kinda just ok. Solid turn your brain off and vibe type of game.

representative_posts.author: squidbian.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: a pretty solid game!!! just dont bother doing all 4 routes/only play as much of it as you want to, as imo its really best enjoyed casually & at ur own pace✌️ (i also recc not looking up what people have and do say abt it online ever. bc theyre all wrong. except for the above advice i just gave LMAO)

representative_posts.author: anormalina.bsky.social

I just figure, cos I entirely missed out, I could experience them the same way others did (and take advantage of disc-to-digital too).

representative_posts.author: tacko3d.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I still have that demo disc. I should try it out. Its stupid enough, I'll find a way to get the game

representative_posts.author: revelo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The first Mass Effect is amazing. The main issues with are clunky combat, a poor inventory system and dodgy vehicle sections. But they are not game breaking flaws. Go play it and enjoy the story. 😄

representative_posts.author: popetherevxxviii.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I didn't have my favorite game played this year is a 12 year old Xbox one game on my bingo card but here we are Although Bakeru on Switch is also a strong contender if not for that Daikon boss...

representative_posts.author: coffeeanddice.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I played Sagrada in Solo mode for first time tonight. It was such a chill game to play. I liked that I could play it on my lap, with all the pieces fitting on the box it comes in. All the built in ways to increase difficulty make this a game I could enjoy on for months. It’s a solid 9/10 for me.

representative_posts.author: peterf5188.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I beat the game. Idc if it was with the cheats turned on. It’s a great game held back by its difficulty. They need a remastered version this.

representative_posts.author: earthboundbooks.bsky.social

perspectives.title: Bad Calls

representative_posts.author: corylav.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Refs rule it was a follow-through by Fabbro. No call

representative_posts.author: lfrum.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Didn't stop me from riding him into the boards, chastising him about his action. After we disengaged, the ref said I could have put him on his butt, and there would have been no call. #ProtectTheGoalie

representative_posts.author: jmeush.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It was another super weak call. Idk if he was even to blame. 3 straight calls that just as easily could have not been called on Bjork.

representative_posts.author: konabrunson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Why did the refs not call the foul on Embiid on that Anunoby trip?? 🧡💙

representative_posts.author: rbpenguinmedia.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 38' Omaha calling for a penalty for that handball, but it was absolutely outside the box. It looked like the ref hesitated to even call it, but he gives a free kick just outside the arc. Gabriel drills the kick into the wall and play continues.

representative_posts.author: boykelly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That play call was so inexcusable. There’s nothing he can do to recover from it

representative_posts.author: drnguyenvanthoc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Was listening to the game so I’m only seeing visuals of this check swing now, and cmon, really? People were upset about this being called a swing? At the very minimum that’s a 50/50 call and being upset about being on the wrong side of a 50/50 call must be a terrible way to live. Also, he went.

representative_posts.author: markumansky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: ok I liked the fake punt call but it was executed in molasses motion

representative_posts.author: wolfgangruck.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The issue with officiating across all sports now is that calls are too subject to interpretation. Is it a push off if the person fouled is fading away? Is the rip through a natural shooting motion? How can a handball in football be subjective? What is considered a catch? What's a check swing?

representative_posts.author: keithsmithnba.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hugo Gonzalez gets an early call tonight. Jordan Walsh fouled Norman Powell twice while he was shooting three-pointers. Powell is a tough cover, but both fouls were avoidable by Walsh.

representative_posts.author: whatabouttob.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Make up call for ripping his head off in regulation and picking up the flag

representative_posts.author: sic-utere.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: lol - during the MVP season most of Brady’s play calls seemed to be, “Ok, it’s a pass play, guys run some routes (doesn’t really matter) and Josh just makes it work.” 😆

Sports.name: NBA Season Start

perspectives.title: Teams Start Strong
perspectives.summary: Teams start strong in NBA games

representative_posts.author: omarisankofa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Other than the bad turnover it's been an assertive start for Cade. On consecutive possessions he hit a pull-up 3, finished a 3-point play and assisted a Reed layup. Slow starts on offense have been an issue for the team these last few games. They need that energy.

representative_posts.author: christopherhine.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nurse calls timeout after the Sixers' second allowed putback. The defensive rebounding at the start of each of the first two games has been subpar. (Has been better in the second halves)

representative_posts.author: robhanna.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Good start, Sixers. Hit a couple tough, tough shots. That long jumper Maxey hit was so pretty.

representative_posts.author: ramblinwreck34.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just imagine If Robinson wasn’t there. All the plays he made were gone. He made a free throw. Offensive rebound to a kick out 3 Screens to create action All players have strength/weaknesses a good team maximize strength and minimize weaknesses to achieve a net positive

representative_posts.author: coolhandnuke.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Devin Booker, alleged NBA superstar, had 3 points in a game the other day. Players have bad games. It’s the rare star who almost never has a clunker.

representative_posts.author: flynny67.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That he's doing the best for the team & someone else can take the load off,he can still lead from the dressing room or sidelines,can't keep playing every minute of every game imo.

representative_posts.author: jlewenberg.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The Raptors have got to be better in transition. This 3-on-1 resulted in a turnover (Quickley bobbling the hit-ahead pass from Barrett). They shot 9-for-16 in transition vs Orlando the other night (started 1-for-6 in that game).

representative_posts.author: leaguepassdelay.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Well, no skips will start the second half. Sixers up 64-60. Bucks actually had the lead entering the final two minutes of the half. I can almost see LeBron complaining at halftime, “C’mon, don’t make me play back to backs…I’m gonna be 42!”

representative_posts.author: mjernst.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hawks survived the 5 minutes of forgetting how to play team defense that is typical of them. Just a shitshow of hesitancy and soft plays. Then Bedard scores and Hawks seem to have woken up in the couple shifts since.

representative_posts.author: jjplfc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think he still has a lot to learn defensively and physically could also improve. Both those things take time, as good a start as he has had this season. My point is should we be relying on him or helping him by making him a key part of a group of 5 that can all play when called on?

Sports.name: Alliance Raid Split

perspectives.title: Alliance Raid Split
perspectives.summary: Alliance raids are being split into two parts

representative_posts.author: faithcharge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: surely the alliance raid changes will only make them take longer to complete in the long run, when they’re not fresh content. old alliance raids are typically like a 30-60m queue outside of the roulette. and now you have to do that twice.

representative_posts.author: sayaaoneko.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: not with you on this. I love alliance raids, I q for them for fun. it is four big boss fights with no q's in between. I like being immersed in content for 30-40 minutes. Now if I want to do an alliance raid it is 2 duties. most people will like it and I respect that but this change is not for me

representative_posts.author: whxmsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: sorry im still thinking about how bad of a decision this is and how it completely misses the mark on why people actually leave alliance raids. because current expac alliance raid queues are actually fine

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This MAY result in one half of a raid being dead weeks after release, and that is a shame, as they are supposed to be complete sections of the experience narratively, and I hope they address that and make it a more comfortable split.

representative_posts.author: whxmsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: the people who leave alliance raids are not people who would otherwise want to do them and dont have time its people who want exp as fast as possible while doing the bare minimum of mechanics.

representative_posts.author: grumbleroar.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I too am in favor of this. Like, lmao I dont wanna be trapped in an alliance raid for long er than i have to

representative_posts.author: battlelitanys.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i seeeee ok thst makes sense… i guess that’s cool then cos clearly they’re gonna stylise the raids themselves to fit around a shorter time frame so it should be more dramatic and cool……

representative_posts.author: wannabeelf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hard same. Although I did go to bed last night wondering if there's any point in my even unlocking the alliance raid series anymore. All splitting the raids in half does for me is double the amount of time I spend waiting in DPS queues.

representative_posts.author: callmenoa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The like one change I’m iffy on that they announced for Evercold is dividing up alliance raids. I assume it will only be for new raids going forward, not retroactive, but worry it will just exacerbate the “crystal tower problem” of people only queueing for the shortest ones

representative_posts.author: channfm.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve seen people say the alliance raid change is unnecessary and like ? It’s really not Do people not realise that some people don’t spend all day on the game They’ll complain about how ffxiv isn’t accessible and when they actually make it more accessible they don’t care

representative_posts.author: bratswayne.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: A bad alliance raid run is nothing more than a mild inconvenience but a bad nier raid will have you convinced hell is real

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: but now there are just 2 raids to queue for and pray that one pops. If you want a certain piece of gear, you only run the half of the raid that one is in, and as AR gear goes, sometimes a lot of it sucks lmao.

representative_posts.author: allaganlizard.etheirys.social
representative_posts.text: It defeats the purpose of the alliance raid to split them up. They were supposed to be longer more traditional MMO raids. This is just 2 normal raids with extra steps. The only problem was having to compete for drops with 23 other randos... and that was easily fixed.

representative_posts.author: bakubread.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It sounded to me like the Alliance Raid division is only going to be a thing going forward, not retroactive, so no probably not

representative_posts.author: yourigath.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This expansion I wanted to run Vana'diel raids because I just love Vana'diel. But the simple thought of having to go through 15min of queue pulse 30-45 mins of raid to maybe get nothing... Yeah, no. The change is AMAZING

representative_posts.author: azure-kitty.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My only real concern is just the pacing break when doing story - new raid might have a logical stop point and build quests around it? But old raids don't have natural pause points storywise, so it just suck from story immersion perspective. Otherwise I have no strong opinions of the change 🤭

representative_posts.author: dreadmanticore.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It really isn't, looking at that posts quotes... I really don't see the issue with it! Queue will be popping so fast! Complete part 1 of the raid, get a drink of water, stretch your legs, come back and do part 2! Idk why people are livid about this...

representative_posts.author: dreadmanticore.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Really don't see the issue with splitting raids into 2 parts. If you really want the full experience, just queue for both halves ig idk.. Queue times probably won't be an issue with the DC changes anyway.

representative_posts.author: kpsoftwind.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think the main that really upsets me is that it’s a double dose of collabs for normal and alliance raids as opposed to original content. Don’t get me wrong, I understand FF7 is pivotal for a lot of folks with enjoy this franchise but seeing them kill it with Arcadion really set a high bar.

representative_posts.author: radelgirl.vanadiel.network
representative_posts.text: Since the eva raid trailer has the wunder.... If they set these raids post rebuild 2.0 I'm giving Yoshi-p a handshake because i feel that's going to make people maaaad lmao

representative_posts.author: comrat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: also if you ever piss them off their raids would be fucking scary like a multi echelon breach assault with artillery support that uses actual strategy

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I personally cannot attest to an AR run taking more than 30 minutes in recent times, but I know long runs happen and they are way too much. I do worry that splitting the raid up will make queue's longer outside of the initial release, because it will still take just as many people to run

representative_posts.author: resaae.vanadiel.network
representative_posts.text: Explorer mode in Alliance Raids (and Baldesion Arsenal!! I mean field ops dungeons as a whole)
